positions.locationName: 32 Maskit Street, P.O. Box 12878, Herzliya, 4673332, Israel
positions.description:
In this project working on the Start project, I'm doing the following activities:

- Developing modules in different areas such as Social Network, Multimedia & Core Android features.
- Bug fixing & improving the application performance.
- Meetings with OEMs & operators such as America Móvil for gathering new requirements for their platforms.
- Defect/Features tracking & project management controlled from Jira for multiple clients.
- Source code management with SVN/Git repositories & automated build system with Jenkins.
- Creation of custom solutions for some OEM's (Device Manufacturers ) over their AOSP package to support special requirements, specially over the SystemUI/Keyguard frameworks.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.celltick.magazine

positions.title: Android Subject Matter Expert/Remote Android Developer
positions.description:
- Developing different Native & Cross-Platform UI Applications for Android & iOS handsets.
- Cross platform development tools: Xamarin & QT.
- Multimedia applications, UI/UX design using material design guidelines & compatibility libraries to support different OS versions
- TDD development & testing frameworks such as Expresso, Robotium & Robolectric
- MVP design pattern using AndroidAnnotations, Dagger & Open Source Libraries
- Support and mentoring to different members of the Android team in the company
- Prepare training materials to teach new members of the Android team for the new technologies

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Jul 2011 – Today
Company: Walmart México y Centro América

Project: UI Application Development for Android, QT & Samsung Smart TV

Summary:  Design & Build the user interface (UI) and write the code for the applications using frameworks Android ADT plugin for Eclipse and QT

Responsibilities: My main responsibilities are the design, implementation and maintenance of the Android applications coding them using the ADT Plugin for Eclipse and also some applications coded with QT Mobile for Android. I coordinated the testing phase with the Test & Graphics Teams and making tracking of issues/suggestions reported by them and make the proper adjustments according to the customer priorities & specifications and finally release the applications to the Play Store. We have in the Play Store the following apps:

-	Superama México
-	Walmart Argentina
-	Walmart Groseries
-	Walmart MG
-	Walmart JIA (Internal used only)

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.superama15.screens&feature=search_result
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.walmart.mg
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.walmart.grocery_ecommerce

These android apps make use of many hardware features, including Camera, Alarm, Email Messaging, Phone Calls, Voice Control, Vibrator and other features like Facebook, Twitter, Barcode Reader, Push Notifications, Paypal, REST services, etc.
 
On the other hand I design a web application for the Samsung Smart TVs (2012 Model) and this application makes use of some hardware resources like: Gesture recognition, Voice Control and Remote Control devices and it’s actually published to the Samsung Market.


Technology and Tools used: QT, QML, SVN, Git, Eclipse + Android SDK + Android Tools, SQLite, Samsung Smart TV SDK, C/C++, Java, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, JQuery, Remote Test Tools for Samsung TVs

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Company: Sferea Games

Project: UI Application Development for QT, Bada and Blackberry

Summary:  Design & Build the user interface (UI) and write the code for the applications

Responsibilities: I developed 12 applications for the Samsung Wave II, 2 applications for the Nokia  QT and 4 applications for Blackberry and all of them published to the Samsung, App World & Ovi stores. They are user oriented apps with excellent look & feel. They were developed for multiple purposes from Academic, Medical, Shopping, Conferences, Social Network, etc. Those apps make use extensively of some hardware features like GPS, Alarms, Calendar and Camera. Other features were also included like Facebook, Twitter and BBM (Blackberry Messenger).

Example of QT App:

http://store.ovi.com/content/136756


Technology and Tools used: Bada IDE, C/C++, Blackberry SDK for Java

positions.title: Senior System Integrator
positions.description:
Project:  Texas Instruments.

Summary:  Integrate and maintain the changes for the Linux Kernel and Multimedia OMX User Apps source trees based on Texas Instruments platforms like OMAP3 and OMAP4.

Responsibilities: My job was basically doing the integration, testing automation, build & release of packages for the Linux Kernel and Multimedia drivers according to the customer needs. I tested & wrote test apps for various drivers like Watchdog, Serial Ports and IrDA, this was to make sure that all the changes made in the development cycle scheduled were done properly. I did the same thing for all the OMX Multimedia components, by doing integration and full testing with automated tools. 

Technology and Tools used: C++, C, OMAP3 platforms, Lauterbach, ARM Cross Compilers, ClearCase, ClearQuest, Git, Gerrit, Poky, Open Source Tools.
